rules.interpretation: Trade only an SPX bear call spread whose two calls expire on the current trading day.
Select the short call near 0.20 delta and the long call exactly five strike points higher.
Open and close both spread legs as one atomic multi-leg package. Never place either leg independently.
Submit at most one new spread package per trading day and manage any existing package before a new entry.
After every order submission, verify the exact order status, open orders, and resulting positions before taking another action.
